articles.title: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax
articles.snippet: Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law.

articles.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
articles.snippet: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the state’s 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.
